projects_description: One continuous workflow from Google Scholar to published results.
onboarding_description: AcademicNetwork identifies the institution in open registries and automatically imports its research output. Google Scholar remains an optional coverage enhancement.
onboarding_ready_help: Continuing will download the institution's research output from OpenAlex. You can follow its progress without keeping this page open.
onboarding_scholar_help: Use it only if the institution does not appear in OpenAlex or if you later want to compare and expand coverage.
onboarding_no_matches: No matches found. Try the official name or remove the country filter.
onboarding_select_source: Select an institution with OpenAlex or add its Scholar organization.
error_authentication_required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error_invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
error_project_access_denied: You do not have access to this project.
error_project_limit_reached: The account has reached its project limit.
error_review_incomplete: Complete the expert review before continuing.
error_workflow_not_awaiting_review: The workflow is not awaiting expert review yet.
error_no_active_review: There is no active expert review.
evaluation_description: Used for pipeline regression; it is not the thesis's human Gold Standard.
evaluation_missing_help: Run the evaluation stage to generate the automatic proxy. Human Gold is managed separately.
evaluation_load_error: The evaluation could not be loaded.
author_load_error: The researcher could not be loaded.
author_scholar_profile_new_tab: Google Scholar profile (opens in a new tab)
publication_load_error: The publication could not be loaded.
network_load_error: The network could not be loaded.
network_nodes_help: Total number of researchers in the co-authorship network. Each node represents one researcher at the institution.
network_edges_help: Total number of co-authorship links. An edge exists when two authors have published together at least once.
network_density_help: Ratio of existing edges to all possible edges, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate a more interconnected community.
network_degree_help: Average number of direct co-authors per researcher. It measures typical collaboration breadth within the institution.
network_components_help: Number of disconnected subnetworks. A value of 1 means all researchers are connected through co-authorship chains.
network_canvas_label: Co-authorship graph with {nodes} nodes and {edges} edges. Use the list below for tabular data.
network_visualization_help: A secondary view for exploring connections.
project_dataset_help: Scholar and OpenAlex form a combined directory. OpenAlex identities with verifiable institutional authorships are included even when Scholar has no equivalent profile.
project_start_scholar_help: The Scholar directory will define the thesis population. When it finishes, OpenAlex will start automatically to complete identities, DOIs, and topics.
project_data_summary: Scholar contributed {authors} profiles and {works} works. OpenAlex reconciled {profiles} identities and added {added} institutional works.
project_catalog_refresh_action: Update directory and rerun from heuristics
project_catalog_refresh_help: Reuses the publications and cached OpenAlex checkpoints. It does not download sources again or use an LLM; it replaces the current operational review while preserving prior runs as history.
project_catalog_refresh_started: Local update started: publications were preserved and processing will resume from the directory and heuristics without an LLM.
project_use_llm: Use an LLM only for persistent ambiguities
project_stage_time: Time in this stage: {elapsed} · Process heartbeat: {heartbeat}
project_processing_help: This page updates automatically. “Process heartbeat” confirms that processing is responsive; “last recorded progress” changes after another work block finishes. You can leave this page: progress is saved.
project_server_failure: The server recorded a failure without details.
project_retry_help: Retry keeps completed stages. Restart runs the analysis again from the beginning; neither option deletes Scholar, OpenAlex, or their checkpoints.
project_identity_help: First confirm the official record OpenAlex will use to supplement the Scholar roster.
project_checkpoint_paused: Checkpoint paused and ready to continue.
project_finishing_before_pause: Finishing the current profile before pausing…
project_import_active: Import is active. Retry remains disabled to prevent two simultaneous captures.
project_reload_connector: If you installed or reloaded the extension while this page was open, reload this tab so Chrome can activate the connector.
project_review_help: Review proceeds in order: quick confirmations first, ambiguities next, and external audit last. Closing is disabled while pending or deferred cases remain.
project_scholar_placeholder: Paste the Scholar organization URL or ID
project_update_extension: Update the extension after completion to enable pause
project_extension_missing: Extension not detected: a copyable code will be used
project_waiting_connector: Waiting for data from the local connector…
project_paused_progress: Import paused; the checkpoint is ready to continue.
project_connector_active_received: The connector is still active · {received} items received so far.
project_scholar_paused_counts: Import paused: {profiles} profiles and {works} works saved.
project_scholar_complete_counts: Scholar import complete: {profiles} profiles and {works} works.
project_openalex_resumed: OpenAlex will continue from the last checkpoint. You can return later.
project_identity_not_found: No usable OpenAlex identity was found for this institution.
project_identity_confirmed: Identity confirmed. Now start the primary import from Google Scholar.
project_scholar_required: Paste the Scholar organization URL or ID.
project_extension_received: The extension received temporary access. Follow progress here; there is no need to copy codes.
project_extension_code_copied: The extension was not detected. The code was copied for use in the manual connector.
project_restarted: Processing restarted from the first analytical stage.
project_review_closed: Review closed; final quality control is running.
abstentions_help: The cascade queries identifiers, registries, and direct sources. Cases without enough evidence end as abstentions, do not remain operational debt, and are excluded from indicators.
abstentions_load_error: The audit could not be loaded.
abstentions_empty: There are no abstentions in the active snapshot
duplicates_help: Each case starts with a pair, but you can add more profiles when one identity is split across three or more records. Choose which profile to keep; the entire merge is grouped and reversible.
duplicates_merge_set_help: Select the canonical profile. The others will redirect to it.
duplicates_add_profile: Add another profile for the same person
duplicates_empty: There are no pairs in this queue.
duplicates_history_help: Audit and Gold Standard traceability, including frozen evidence and undone merges.
duplicates_no_history: No merges have been recorded yet.
duplicates_busy_help: The page will continue automatically when the operation finishes.
duplicates_load_error: The queue could not be loaded.
duplicates_merge_error: The profiles could not be merged.
duplicates_gold_error: The Gold label could not be saved.
duplicates_undo_error: The merge could not be undone.
duplicates_undo_batch_error: The batch could not be undone.
duplicates_review_error: The review could not be saved.
duplicates_confirm_merge: Merge {count} profiles and keep {name} as the canonical identity? The active signature review will close.
duplicates_confirm_undo: Undo this merge? Derived projections will be rebuilt.
duplicates_confirm_undo_batch: Undo every merge in this batch? Derived projections will be rebuilt.
duplicates_preparing_help: The directory is consolidated. We will resume review preparation and take you to its progress.
duplicates_merging_help: Profiles, signatures, authorships, and co-authorship relationships are being consolidated. This may take a moment; do not close this window.
duplicates_saving_different: Saving that they are different people
duplicates_saving_help: The queue is being updated and the next step will be checked automatically.
validation_help: Move from the clearest confirmations to cases requiring more verification.
validation_maintenance_help: You can inspect evidence, but decisions are disabled until the run passes the integrity audit.
validation_preview: Preview · enabled after the previous step
validation_preview_title: This phase is still a preview
validation_preview_help: Review must proceed in order. Return to the current step to accept, mark as external, or defer cases.
validation_duplicates_first_help: Do not choose here between two records that may represent the same person. Compare their profiles, merge only when supported by evidence, then return to this signature.
validation_merge_warning: A merge changes the canonical directory. For safety, this run will close and a new review must be prepared.
validation_go_duplicate: Go to the duplicate profile pair
validation_representative_help: Includes the strongest and weakest contexts and temporal extremes to avoid deciding from a single example.
validation_primary_confirmed: Authorship corroborated in a primary source
validation_no_source_publication: This occurrence has no linked source publication.
validation_comparison_help: Figures are comparative signals, not probabilities. Verify publications, topics, and co-authorship before confirming.
validation_no_coauthor_connection: No connection to source co-authors was detected.
validation_alias_option: The option to save an alias will appear before confirmation.
validation_occurrence_no_alias: This decision resolves only the current publication; it will not create a global alias.
validation_no_preselected: No compatible person is preselected. Search the directory and compare against every occurrence before deciding.
validation_search_other: Search for another person in the directory
validation_search_other_help: The comparison will be calculated for every occurrence in this group.
validation_search_other_help_occurrence: The comparison will use only the evidence from this publication.
validation_identified_external_label: External identity verified by the source
validation_identified_external_help: OpenAlex linked the signature to this person, who does not match an active identity in the institutional directory.
validation_prepare_duplicates_help: There are {count} pending or deferred pairs. Resolving them first avoids building a review with profiles that later disappear after merging.
validation_preparing_help: The directory is stable; candidates and decision groups are now being rebuilt.
validation_ready_new: The directory is ready for a new review
validation_ready_new_help: The previous run became obsolete after a canonical identity changed. Prepare a new snapshot before making more decisions.
validation_no_deferred: There are no deferred groups in this phase
validation_up_to_date: This phase is up to date
pipeline_completed_success: Pipeline run completed: {matched} enriched and {deferred} deferred.
pipeline_connection_lost: The connection to the server was lost. Refresh the page.
pipeline_evidence_help: Uses the model configured in CLAUDE_EVIDENCE_MODEL_ID, adaptive thinking, and closed bibliographic evidence. It does not make identity decisions.
pipeline_model_help: Select a specific model or use the server-configured default.
pipeline_workers_help: Parallel workers for LLM calls. Defaults: Claude=2, Ollama=4, and RunPod=20. Reduce the value for local models to avoid saturation (for example, Ollama=1).
pipeline_budget_help: If the estimated cost exceeds this value, Claude is skipped entirely and no calls are made. Leave it empty for no limit.
pipeline_limit_full_help: Shared cap for profile extraction and enrichment.
pipeline_limit_csv_help: Cap for enrichment; useful for partial runs.
pipeline_limit_profile_help: Maximum number of author profiles to visit and scrape.
pipeline_limit_enrich_help: Maximum number of publications to enrich through OpenAlex.
pipeline_csv_full_help: Read and write directory during the run.
pipeline_csv_existing_help: Must contain the CSV files previously generated by extract → normalize → profile.
pipeline_csv_migrate_help: CSV source directory for migration stages.
pipeline_openalex_workers_help: Parallel workers for the OpenAlex API. Default: 4.
pilot_intro: Create a manual reference for comparing models. This individual pilot never changes the operational network.
pilot_step_freeze: The system freezes occurrences and candidates without revealing previous decisions.
pilot_step_label: First identify the person, then classify their affiliation in that publication; abstain when evidence is insufficient.
pilot_step_export: Finalize and export a snapshot ready for model comparison.
pilot_not_formal: This mode does not measure inter-curator agreement and is not presented as a formal Gold Standard.
pilot_distribution: Default: 40 with several candidates, 20 with one, 25 with no strict candidate but a verified source, and 15 to measure abstention.
pilot_identity_help_short: Select the person whose bibliographic history best matches this publication.
pilot_candidates_blind: Candidates are in random order; scores and system decisions are hidden.
pilot_case_reading_guide: Read the case from top to bottom: identify the publication, consult the documentary support if needed, and then compare the candidate people.
pilot_no_candidates_explainer: No strict candidates were generated. This does not prove that the person is outside the directory.
pilot_evidence_ready: Documentary support is available for reviewing the byline
pilot_evidence_insufficient: There is not enough documentary support to confirm the identity
pilot_evidence_conflict: The consulted records do not agree
pilot_publication_context_help: The question is whether the signature “{signature}” belongs to a person in the directory. The title, byline, and topic provide context for comparing identities.
pilot_documentary_support_help: We found at least one independent record that matches this publication and exposes its byline. This supports the article metadata, but does not by itself decide which directory person matches the signature.
pilot_show_source_details: View supporting records and reported affiliations ({count})
pilot_source_details_help: These details show where the names and affiliations came from. They are neither a system decision nor an additional candidate.
pilot_identity_step_help: Compare the signature, the source byline, and the bibliographic profile. The current affiliation shown in the directory is context only; it does not answer where the person worked when this article was published.
pilot_author_selected: Person selected; historical affiliation still needs confirmation
pilot_affiliation_step_title: Which institution did this person sign the article with?
pilot_affiliation_step_help: Answer from the affiliations reported by the source for this publication. Do not automatically use the profile's current affiliation.
pilot_combined_decision_title: This is how the decision will be saved
pilot_identity_affiliation_separate: The directory currently shows “{current}”. Record the affiliation reported for this publication here.
pilot_select_before_confirm: Select a person first. If none matches or evidence is missing, use the options below.
pilot_alternative_title: Do none of the candidates support an identity decision?
pilot_alternative_help: Search for another person, choose not in the directory only when identity is clear, or select insufficient evidence when no reliable conclusion is possible.
pilot_affiliation_question: Affiliation at the time of publication
pilot_label_saved: This case already has a saved label.
pilot_replace_warning: Selecting another option will replace the previous decision.
pilot_go_next_flagged: Go to next case to review
pilot_delete_help: This permanently deletes “{name}”, its {caseCount} occurrences, and {labelCount} saved labels. This action cannot be undone.
pilot_delete_export_help: Files you already exported will not be deleted.
pilot_delete_error: The sample could not be deleted.
pilot_independent_profile: Profile independent of the current article
pilot_insufficient_profile: There is not enough independent bibliographic evidence to summarize this profile.
pilot_external_source_title: The source identifies a person outside the directory
pilot_external_source_help: OpenAlex links this signature to the following person and reports an external affiliation for this publication. Confirm only when the name and article match; the sample never saves this decision automatically.
pilot_capture_complete_help: There are no pending or marked cases. You can review and change any occurrence; labels remain editable until you choose to finalize the sample.
pilot_immutable_help: The {count} human labels are frozen and did not affect the operational workflow.
pilot_directory_help: Alphabetical search without recommendations. Compare the profile first; confirmation is a separate step.
pilot_load_error: The quick samples could not be loaded.
pilot_open_error: This sample could not be opened.
pilot_created: Sample frozen directly from the database. You can start labeling now.
pilot_create_error: The sample could not be generated.
pilot_advance_error: The label was saved, but the next case could not be opened. Reload the page to continue.
pilot_save_error: The label could not be saved.
pilot_navigation_error: The case could not be changed.
pilot_directory_error: The frozen directory could not be searched.
pilot_finalized_notice: Sample finalized. Its labels and evidence are now immutable.
pilot_finalize_error: The sample could not be finalized.
pilot_exported_notice: A benchmark-compatible snapshot was generated successfully.
pilot_export_error: The snapshot could not be exported.
gold_intro: Three curators group signatures blindly. Their decisions do not change the operational network until the study is frozen, evaluated, and a manager authorizes promotion.
gold_no_study_help: Creating the draft does not sample cases, create users, or change signatures. You must then add exactly three curator accounts before starting.
gold_step_freeze_sample: Freeze a stratified sample of 400 cases.
gold_run_help: The active audited run is suggested automatically; you can replace it with another stable v8 run.
gold_team_help: The current manager is already listed as manager and adjudicator. Add three existing users as curators.
gold_sample_help: Seed: {seed}. The button will fail without changing data if any stratum lacks enough cases.
gold_blind_help: Decide which signatures belong to the same person. Candidates, scores, phases, and system decisions are hidden.
gold_no_source: No source publication could be retrieved; you may leave the case unresolved.
gold_cluster_placeholder: E.g. person-a; use the same value for the same identity
gold_annotation_manager_help: The manager only sees aggregate progress; decisions and predictions remain hidden.
gold_no_task: You have no other pending task. Predictions remain hidden until the freeze.
gold_adjudicate_help: Compare clusters C01, C02, and C03. The system prediction remains hidden.
gold_final_partition_help: Assign the final partition below using the same blind-space controls. Every disagreement must be resolved.
gold_freeze_help: If no disagreements remain, freeze the Gold Standard. The system will verify that all 400 cases have a final decision.
gold_exact_author_help: Only Gold cases assigned to a UdeC author
gold_evaluate_help: The frozen prediction can now be compared with the human Gold Standard.
gold_promotion_help: This action applies the decisions to the expert workflow. It is idempotent and will not create aliases. Unresolved cases remain deferred.
gold_promotion_confirm: I confirm that I reviewed the metrics and want to apply this Gold Standard to the operational run.
gold_directory_help: Alphabetical results without system ranking or recommendations.
gold_source_run_required: Enter the v8 run to freeze as the source.
gold_created_notice: The draft was created without sampling cases or changing the operational review.
gold_create_error: The study could not be created.
gold_curator_added: Curator added to the study with an anonymous code.
gold_add_curator_error: The curator could not be added.
gold_started_notice: Sample frozen. System predictions are now hidden from curators.
gold_complete_error: Resolve every case and assign each one to a cluster before submitting.
gold_submitted_notice: Task submitted. It can no longer be edited.
gold_save_error: The task could not be saved.
gold_adjudication_incomplete: The final decision must cover the entire namespace.
gold_adjudicated_notice: Disagreement adjudicated without revealing the system prediction.
gold_adjudicate_error: The task could not be adjudicated.
gold_frozen_notice: Gold Standard frozen. Predictions may now be revealed.
gold_freeze_error: Some tasks still lack a final decision.
gold_evaluated_notice: Reproducible evaluation generated in CSV, JSON, and Markdown.
gold_evaluate_error: The study could not be evaluated.
gold_promoted_notice: Promotion complete: {summary}. No aliases were created.
gold_promote_error: The decisions could not be promoted.
gold_load_error: The Gold studies could not be loaded.

validation_related_help: They share the same signature, but each publication is decided separately.

validation_question_weak: Is there enough evidence to assign “{signature}” to the only retrieved candidate?
validation_question_conflict: How should the conflicting evidence for “{signature}” in this occurrence be resolved?

validation_save_error: The decision could not be saved.
validation_deferred_notice: {signature} was deferred without changing any identity.

validation_derived_updated: The network and indicators are up to date.
validation_derived_queued: The network and indicator update was queued.
validation_derived_error: The update could not be started.
validation_no_source_occurrence: This occurrence has no linked source publication.
validation_no_active_authors: No active authors were found for “{query}”.
validation_complete_help: The guided workflow is complete. Cases without data remain in their technical queue and were not converted into identity decisions.
validation_continue_current: Continue with the step marked as current.
validation_continue_next: Continuing automatically advances the review to the next difficulty level.
validation_confirm_occurrences_help: All occurrences of {signature} will be assigned to {name} in one operation.
validation_save_alias: Save as an alias for future runs.
validation_save_alias_help: This is optional and global; leave it unchecked if you are only resolving these contexts.
validation_verify_external_help: This decision states that {signature} does not correspond to an active person in the directory. Select the evidence that supports it.
validation_already_reviewed: This group was already reviewed by someone else.
validation_author_inactive: The selected author is no longer active in the directory.
validation_undo_owner: Only the reviewer who made this decision can undo it.

pipeline_stage_extract_desc: Scrape the Google Scholar organization list
pipeline_stage_extract_detail: Uses Playwright to extract names, affiliations, and profile links from the Google Scholar organization and saves them as CSV.
pipeline_stage_normalize_detail: Trims whitespace, removes duplicates, separates compound names, and standardizes extracted author formatting.
pipeline_stage_profile_desc: Visit profiles for publications and metrics
pipeline_stage_profile_detail: Visits each Google Scholar profile and collects publications, coauthors, and metrics such as h-index and i10-index.
pipeline_stage_db_profile_detail: Collects the same profile information and writes it directly to PostgreSQL. Requires a previous migration.
pipeline_stage_migrate_desc: Load all CSV files into the database
pipeline_stage_migrate_detail: Loads CSV files into PostgreSQL using upserts and recalculates relationships and author positions. Safe to rerun.
pipeline_stage_enrich_desc: Query OpenAlex for DOI and metadata
pipeline_stage_enrich_detail: Adds DOI, abstract, type, source, and external citations through OpenAlex. It is resumable and respects API limits.
pipeline_stage_disambiguate_desc: AND pipeline to cluster and resolve
pipeline_stage_disambiguate_detail: Runs name clustering, institutional filtering, and BGE-M3 semantic resolution, with an optional LLM fallback.
pipeline_stage_review_enrich_detail: Refreshes only publications used in the expert queue and never changes author identities.
pipeline_stage_review_build_desc: Build topic, publication, and coauthor comparisons
pipeline_stage_review_build_detail: Creates versioned, explainable evidence for pending, deferred, and possible-duplicate cases.
pipeline_stage_indicators_detail: Computes bibliometric and network indicators per author and adds a snapshot for longitudinal analysis.
pipeline_stage_evaluate_desc: Build the Gold Standard and score AND
pipeline_stage_evaluate_detail: Builds the Gold Standard and computes formal metrics for the AND system and a name-only baseline.
pipeline_stage_csv_desc: Database pipeline when CSV files already exist
pipeline_stage_csv_detail: Runs migrate → enrich → disambiguate → indicators with existing CSV files. Every stage is idempotent.
pipeline_stage_full_detail: Runs all seven stages in order from extraction to indicators. Requires PostgreSQL, network access, and Playwright.
import_failed: The import could not be completed.
pipeline_budget_exhausted: The OpenAlex budget is temporarily exhausted.
pilot_benchmark_help: Compare models against your frozen labels. This run only creates evaluation results and never changes the operational network.
pilot_benchmark_load_error: The benchmark configuration could not be loaded.
pilot_benchmark_frozen_help: Every model receives exactly the same evidence. Use this for a fair model comparison.
pilot_benchmark_search_help: Each provider may retrieve additional evidence. This compares model plus retrieval, not only the model.
pilot_benchmark_smoke_help: {count} cases per model to verify configuration and output format before using more requests.
pilot_benchmark_full_help: Evaluate all {count} cases and the stability repetitions included in the sample.
pilot_benchmark_search_unavailable_help: One or more selected models cannot browse. Add the indicated credential or use frozen evidence.
pilot_benchmark_request_summary: This will make {requests} requests: {models} models × {perModel} requests per model.
pilot_benchmark_confirm_help: This action will make real calls to the selected providers. Review the scope before continuing.
pilot_benchmark_confirm_coding: GLM models will use the configured Coding Plan endpoint. The report's cost figure uses reference prices and is not necessarily an additional plan charge.
pilot_benchmark_start_error: The benchmark could not be started.
pilot_benchmark_poll_error: The progress could not be refreshed.
pilot_benchmark_accuracy_help: Identity requires the correct person. The joint result also requires the affiliation at publication time.
pilot_benchmark_run_notice: Benchmark started. You may leave this screen; it will continue in the background.
pilot_readonly_help: This sample is closed. You can review its occurrences and decisions. To change anything you must reopen it, which deletes its benchmarks.
pilot_no_saved_decision: This occurrence has no saved decision.
pilot_edit_confirm_help: The occurrences and labels in “{name}” will be kept so you can correct them.
pilot_edit_confirm_warning: Model responses will be preserved. After exporting again, accuracy, errors, and comparisons will be recalculated against the corrected labels.
pilot_edit_operational_safe: The operational network will not be changed.
pilot_catalog_rebase_title: Create a revision using the current directory
pilot_catalog_rebase_help: The exact same occurrences are preserved, while candidates and sources are rebuilt from the enriched directory. Labels that remain valid are copied; only affected cases become pending.
pilot_catalog_rebase_history: The current sample and all of its benchmarks remain available as history. Previous results are not mixed into the new version because they evaluated different evidence.
pilot_catalog_rebase_notice: Revision created: {carried} labels preserved, {review} cases to review, and {benchmarks} historical benchmarks retained.
pilot_catalog_rebase_error: The sample could not be updated to the current directory.
pilot_reopened_notice: Sample reopened. {count} benchmark runs were preserved; their results will be recalculated on export.
pilot_reopen_error: The sample could not be reopened for editing.
pilot_benchmark_waiting_provider: Waiting for the provider response. The counter increases when each request finishes; some models may take several minutes.
pilot_benchmark_parallel_help: Independent providers run in parallel; models sharing a provider wait in the same lane to respect its quota.
pilot_benchmark_reasoning_scope: This shows the explanation included by the model and the raw content received. The provider's hidden internal reasoning is not available.
pilot_benchmark_responses_error: The benchmark responses could not be loaded.
pilot_benchmark_no_responses: This model does not have any saved responses yet.
pilot_benchmark_total_cost_help: Sum of every request and model cost. For Coding Plan, this is the standard API reference equivalent.
pilot_benchmark_mismatch_affiliation: The person matches; the historical affiliation does not.
pilot_benchmark_mismatch_identity: The selected identity does not match the sample.
pilot_benchmark_mismatch_other: The model decision does not match the sample.
pilot_benchmark_rescored_notice: Results recalculated after label corrections; the original model responses were preserved.
dimensions_explanation: Retrieve authorship and affiliations declared in this publication. The result supplies evidence for review; directory identity is decided separately.
dimensions_missing_key: Dimensions is not configured on the server.
dimensions_empty: This publication has not been queried yet.
dimensions_no_authors: No authorship available for a validated bibliographic match.
dimensions_status_conflict: Review needed: ambiguous or conflicting data
